newsitem.title: USA: FAC Realty Trust will not pay Q4 dividend.
newsitem.headline: FAC Realty Trust will not pay Q4 dividend.

text.p: FAC Realty Trust Inc said its board has decided against paying a dividend for the fourth quarter of 1996.
Additionally, the company said future dividends will be equal to 95 percent of its taxable income, the minimum required to maintain its status as a real estate investment trust.

"The decision not to pay a dividend for the fourth quarter is a component of our financial restructuring," the company said in an announcement late on Wednesday, when it also reported the resignation of its chairman and a fourth quarter loss of $0.53 per share, compared to a loss of $1.74 in the year-ago quarter.
The company's funds from operations were a profit of $0.27 per share, compared to a year-ago loss of $0.21 per share.

"While establishing future dividends equal to 95 percent of (our) taxable income will result in lower dividends than we paid in 1996, this policy will help ensure a better overall return to our shareholders and protect our ability to generate internal funds for future growth," the company said.
The company's quarterly dividend had been set at $0.25 per share.
